_note: G1/G1-b presumption windows (GEO rulings, 2026-06). For run-implying types with NULL end_date, the event is presumed running until start_date + presumed_run_days; past the window, eventStatus is OMITTED (never EventCompleted from presumption) and the page cools to noindex (never 410). Values are citability semantics — GEO's to change, not dev's. Keys in presumed_run_days (except _default) MUST appear in runImplyingTypes; the loader rejects otherwise.
